title: Evidence runbook — daily pilot notes
content:
Quick morning runbook (scratchpad) — SOC2 evidence + vendor checks

Purpose: lightweight daily notes for collecting files + blocking items. Not meant to be polished. Use for handoff if I’m OOO.

Top objectives for today:
- Finish evidence bundle for access control (ACLs/IAM) for audit window: 2025-09-01 -> 2026-03-01 (deadline 2026-03-16).
- Triage VendorX questionnaire + gather supporting docs (contracts, security addenda).
- Quick policy TODOs: sign-off on new S3 encryption policy draft.

Evidence checklist (working):
- iam-roles-export-2026-03-10.csv  <-- exported from infra-ops (confirm currently scoped to prod accounts)
- s3-bucket-policies-screenshots.zip  <-- include bucket-level policy & ACL screens
- cloudtrail-delivery-status-2026-03-01-to-2026-03-10.json  <-- raw, grep for PutObject/DeleteObject
- kms-key-rotation-report-2026-02.pdf
- mfa-enrollment-report-2026-03-02.csv  <-- list of users + mfa enabled flag
- onboarding-access-flow.docx  <-- updated flow for org SSO -> SCIM provisioning
- vendorx-security-questionnaire-v3.pdf  <-- questionnaire answers from vendor
- contracts/vendorx-dpa-signed-2025-11-02.pdf

Notes to self (short):
- Ask infra-ops for a filtered CloudTrail for service-principal activity (search for AssumeRole with external-id) — Marcus to help.
- Priya to confirm whether vendorx uses shared-hosted environment or dedicated tenancy (affects control mapping).
- Save final IAM evidence to evidence-bucket/evidence-packages/soc2-2026-q1/ — naming: redwood-soc2-q1-iam-{date}.zip

Vendor quick rubric (one-pager idea):
- Score 1–5 (1 low risk / 5 high risk) across 4 axes: Data separation, Encryption & keys, Incident history, Controls maturity.
- Example: VendorX = 3 (data separation: 2, encryption: 2, incident history: 4, controls maturity: 3) -> overall 3 (follow-up items: ask for pen-test report + SOC2 Type II hire date).

Immediate TO-DOS (priority order):
1) Get IAM export from infra-ops + check for orphaned roles (ETA today EOD) [owner: Marcus]
2) Pull CloudTrail filter (AssumeRole / PutObject) for audit samples (ETA tomorrow) [owner: Aisha]
3) Draft short email to legal to confirm if VendorX DPA covering subcontractors (ETA today) [owner: Aisha]
4) Add S3 encryption policy comments inline (link to Confluence) [owner: Priya, ETA 2026-03-15]

Meeting prep: 15-min sync with SEC team @ 10:30
- Agenda: go/no-go on IAM evidence bundle; vendorx follow-ups; quick risk heatmap refresh
- Bring: sample IAM export, one CloudTrail sample, vendorx questionnaire summary (top 5 gaps)

Open questions / blockers:
- Are we OK shipping raw CloudTrail JSON to evidence-bucket or should we redact PII first? (legal input needed)
- Does infra-ops have a nightly job to export IAM role metadata? If not, schedule a short run.
- Who on legal is point for subcontractor disclosure? (tagging legal slack: @legal-team)

Hand-off notes (if I leave these to someone else):
- Follow the checklist above, keep filenames consistent, ask Marcus for the IAM CSV, drop findings into the audit sheet: /confluence/SOC2+Evidence+Index -> table row for each artifact.
- When packaging, include a manifest.txt with source, run command, and extraction notes. Example manifest line: iam-roles-export-2026-03-10.csv | aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[*].{RoleName:RoleName, Arn:Arn}' > iam-roles-export-2026-03-10.csv

Scratchy thoughts / brainstorms:
- Could do a quick lambda to redact sensitive fields from CloudTrail for evidence uploads (strip IPs/emails) -> quick PoC by end of week? Low effort.
- Make a tiny rubric template (sheet) to score vendors quickly on intake (map to control families).

Final quick log (timestamps):
- 08:42 start, reviewed vendorx questionnaire (noted missing pen-test date)
- 09:05 pinged Marcus for IAM CSV
- 09:28 flagged legal for subcontractor question
- 09:33 started this doc (scratchpad)

-- end of runbook note --

(Keep this as living scratchpad. Move to confluence once cleaned.)
